blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: LiDAR point cloud semantic segmentation is a fundamental component of 3D perception for autonomous driving and robotics. Projection-based methods map 3D point clouds into 2D representations for feature extraction using 2D networks. However, aggregating multiple points during projection can obscure geometric differences within each frustum, while local feature extraction limits the modeling of spatial relationships across scanning regions. Moreover, proximity in the projected representation does not necessarily imply proximity in 3D space, and interactions between point and projected features may mix features from different ranges, reducing semantic discriminability. To address these challenges, we propose the Ray-aligned and Scan-aware Fusion Network (RaSFNet), which incorporates point cloud geometry and LiDAR scanning characteristics into projection-based semantic segmentation. Specifically, the Ray-Aligned Geometric Distribution Encoding (RAGDE) module characterizes point distributions within each frustum using a ray-aligned coordinate system. To model spatial context, a Scan-Topology-Aware Mamba (STAM) block organizes frustum features according to the LiDAR azimuth sampling pattern and captures long-range dependencies across scanning regions. In addition, a Range-Constrained Point-Frustum Fusion (RCPFF) mechanism uses shared range information to guide feature exchange between point and frustum representations while maintaining spatial correspondence. RaSFNet achieves mIoU scores of 70.2% and 77.7% on the SemanticKITTI and nuScenes validation sets, respectively, indicating competitive segmentation performance compared with the evaluated methods.
blocks.zh: LiDAR点云语分区是自主驱动和机器人的3D感知的一个基本组成部分. 基于投影的方法将3D点云映射为2D表示,用于利用2D网络提取特征. 然而,在投影过程中汇总多个点会模糊每个节点内的几何差异,而局部特征提取则限制了跨扫描区域的空间关系的模型化. 此外,预测表达方式的接近并不一定意味着3D空间的接近,点与预测特征之间的相互作用可能混合不同范围的特征,从而减少语义上的区别性. 为了应付这些挑战,我们提议建立雷线相通和扫描感应网络(RSFNet),将点云几何和LiDAR扫描特性纳入投影语义分解中。 具体来说,Ray-accessed几何分布编码(RAGDE)模块使用射线耦合坐标系统来描述每个节内点分布. 为了模拟空间背景,一个Scan-Topology-Aware Mamba(STAM)块按照LiDAR方位角取样模式组织frustum特征,并捕捉跨扫描区域的远程依赖性. 此外,Range-Construction Point-Frustum Fusion(RCPFF)机制使用共享范围信息指导点与节点表示之间的特征交换,同时保持空间对应. RaSFNet在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes验证集上分别取得了70.2%和77.7%的mIoU分数,表明与被评价方法相比,有竞争力的分区性能.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: LiDAR point cloud semantic segmentation is a fundamental task for 3D scene understanding, providing fine-grained environmental perception for autonomous driving, robotic navigation, and intelligent transportation systems, and serving as an essential foundation for outdoor autonomous decision-making [ 1 ] , [ 2 ] . However, LiDAR point clouds acquired in real-world outdoor environments are inherently characterized by irregular spatial distributions, sparsity, and highly non-uniform point densities, which make it challenging for existing models to effectively capture fine-grained geometric structures [ 3 ] , [ 4 ] , [ 5 ] . Consequently, spatially adjacent ground classes with similar geometric characteristics, such as parking areas, sidewalks, and terrain, can be easily confused, limiting segmentation accuracy and the capability of existing models to meet the demands of complex outdoor perception [ 6 ] , [ 7 ] , [ 8 ] , [ 9 ] , [ 10 ] . Therefore, developing feature modeling methods tailored to the inherent characteristics of LiDAR point clouds, which can jointly capture fine-grained geometric details and global spatial dependencies, is crucial for improving semantic segmentation performance in complex outdoor scenes and remains a key challenge in 3D LiDAR perception [ 11 ] , [ 12 ] .
blocks.zh: LiDAR点云语分解是3D场景理解的基本任务,为自主驾驶,机器人导航,智能交通系统提供精细的环境感知,并成为室外自主决策的重要基础[1],[2]. 然而,在现实世界户外环境中得到的LiDAR点云的内在特征是空间分布不规则,相扑性强,且高度非统一点密度高,这使得现有模型难以有效捕捉出细纹几何结构[3],[4],[5]. 因此,具有类似几何特征的相邻地层,如停车区,人行道,地势等,很容易被混淆,限制了分区精度和现有模型满足复杂户外感知需求的能力 [6], [7], [8], [9], [10]. 因此,开发适合LiDAR点云固有特征的特征模型方法,可以联合捕捉精细的几何细节和全球空间依赖性,对于提高复杂室外场景的语义分解性能至关重要,仍然是3D LiDAR感知 [11], [12]的关键挑战.

blocks.en: Considering that LiDAR acquires three-dimensional structural information by continuously scanning the surrounding environment with multiple laser beams along the horizontal direction, the resulting point clouds preserve regular spatial indexing relationships in the angular domain [ 13 ] , [ 14 ] . Building on this property, range-image methods [ 15 ] , [ 16 ] , [ 17 ] , [ 7 ] employ spherical projection to determine the row and column positions of each 3D point on a 2D grid according to its elevation and azimuth angles, transforming irregular point clouds into structured 2D representations. Such representations preserve the intrinsic scanning geometry and support the use of mature 2D backbone networks, providing structured inputs for LiDAR perception and making range-view methods a mainstream paradigm for point cloud semantic segmentation. However, projecting 3D point clouds onto a fixed-resolution 2D grid is inherently a lossy spatial compression process that cannot fully preserve the original three-dimensional structural information [ 18 ] , [ 19 ] . On the one hand, multiple points at different ranges may be mapped to the same pixel, causing projection conflicts and the loss of local geometric details. On the other hand, sparse LiDAR sampling can lead to insufficient feature information in critical regions. These issues introduce discrepancies between 2D pixel adjacency and the 3D spatial topology, making it difficult to accurately capture geometric relationships in complex scenes and limiting the model's ability to effectively represent complete three-dimensional structures [ 7 ] , [ 8 ] , [ 9 ] , [ 18 ] , [ 19 ] , [ 20 ] .
blocks.zh: 考虑到LiDAR通过沿着水平方向用多道激光束连续扫描周围环境而获得三维结构信息,所形成的点云在角域中保持了经常性的空间索引关系[13],[14]. 在这个属性的基础上,射程成像法 [15], [16], [17], [7] 采用球形投影法,根据2D网格上每个立体点的高和方位角确定其行和列位置,将不规则点云转化为结构化的2D表示. 这种表达方式保留了内在的扫描几何,支持了成熟的2D骨干网络的使用,为LiDAR的感知提供了有条理的输入,使测距方法成为点云语义分解的主流范式. 然而,将三维点云投射到固定分辨率2D网格上,本质上是一种失落的空间压缩过程,无法完全保存出原来的三维结构信息 [18], [19]. 一方面,不同范围内的多点可能被映射到相同的像素上,导致投影冲突并丢失了局部几何细节. 另一方面,LiDAR采样稀少可能导致关键地区特征信息不足. 这些问题引入了2D像素相接和3D空间地貌相接的差异,使得在复杂的场景中难以准确捕捉几何关系,并限制了模型有效代表完整三维结构[7],[8],[9],[18],[19],[20]的能力.

blocks.en: Notably, the aforementioned projection issues are not limited to the representation of raw point clouds and may be further amplified by data augmentation strategies [ 9 ] , [ 17 ] . A common strategy is to copy local point sets from other scenes into the current scene [ 21 ] , [ 22 ] , enriching scene compositions and object distributions in the training data while alleviating overfitting to specific point cloud distributions. Although such methods can generate richer scene layouts in 3D space, they typically focus on the geometric plausibility of insertion positions while overlooking LiDAR ray visibility and occlusion constraints [ 9 ] , [ 20 ] . In a LiDAR system, only the first valid return along a given laser direction is generally retained [ 16 ] , [ 17 ] . After external point sets are introduced, newly inserted points may share the same scanning direction as foreground points in the original scene. As illustrated in Fig. 1 , when the augmented point cloud is projected onto the range image, points with different ranges and semantic labels may fall into the same image cell, disturbing the local distributions of range, intensity, and geometric features.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,上述预测问题并不限于原始点云的表示,而且可能通过数据扩增战略而得到进一步扩大[9],[17]. 一个共同的策略是将其他场景的局部点集复制到当前场景中[21],[22],丰富场景组成和在训练数据中的对象分布,同时缓解与特定点云分布的过度相适应. 虽然这些方法可以在3D空间中产生更丰富的场景布局,但它们通常侧重于插入位置的几何可视性,同时俯瞰LiDAR射线能见度和被遮住的限制[9],[20]. 在LiDAR系统中,一般只保留沿给定的激光方向的第一个有效回放. blocks.en: To alleviate the information loss caused by projection conflicts, existing studies organize multiple points mapped to the same grid location into local frustum units and encode them as 2D frustum features [ 9 , 20 , 12 ] . A bidirectional fusion mechanism is established between 3D point features and 2D frustum features, allowing the original point information in overlapping projection regions to continuously participate in iterative feature updates and alleviating the information compression caused by single-pixel representations. Despite this improvement, the intrinsic characteristics of LiDAR point clouds remain insufficiently exploited in 3D structure encoding, frustum feature extraction, and feature fusion, limiting the modeling of geometric and topological relationships in complex scenes and the discrimination of spatially adjacent structures with similar geometry, as illustrated in Fig. 1 .
blocks.zh: 为了减轻投影冲突造成的信息损失,现有研究将多个点被映射到同一个网格位置,并被编码为2D frustum特征[9,20,12]. 在3D点特征和2D frustum特征之间建立了双向聚变机制,使重叠投影区域的原始点信息能持续地参与迭接地物更新并缓解由单像素表示所引发的信息压缩. 尽管有了这些改进,LiDAR点云的内在特征在3D结构编码,花纹特征取出和特征聚变中仍然没有得到充分的利用,限制了复杂场景中几何和地貌关系的模型化,也限制了具有类似几何的相邻空间结构的区别,如图1所说明.

blocks.en: Motivated by the above limitations, we propose a new method for collaborative learning between 3D structural features and 2D frustum features, termed the Ray-aligned and Scan-aware Fusion Network (RaSFNet), which enhances fine-grained 3D structure discrimination and improves the representation of geometrically similar objects in complex scenes. To distinguish different range distributions and geometric patterns within each frustum, we design a Ray-Aligned Geometric Distribution Encoding (RAGDE) module. Points are explicitly represented by their radial range and tangential offsets in a ray-aligned coordinate system, while multi-frequency sine and cosine functions are used for Fourier feature [ 23 ] mapping to enhance the representation differences among distinct spatial organization patterns. To enhance the global modeling capability of frustum features, we design a Scan-Topology-Aware Mamba (STAM) block. The module sequentially organizes features according to the LiDAR azimuth sampling pattern and leverages Mamba [ 24 ] to capture long-range dependencies across scanning regions, improving the representation of structural variations among different scan regions and global spatial relationships. To address the decoupling between 3D structural features and 2D frustum features during deep interaction, we introduce a a Range-Constrained Point-Frustum Fusion (RCPFF) mechanism that uses distance information as a shared cue linking 2D projections and 3D spatial structures, guiding the collaborative update of both feature types while enhancing spatial consistency and semantic complementarity.
blocks.zh: 受上述限制的驱使,我们提出一种新的方法,在3D结构特征和2D Frustum特征之间进行协作学习,称为Ray-accessed and Scan-aware Fusion Network (RSFNet),它强化了精细的3D结构歧视,并改进了几何相近物体在复杂场景中的体现. 为了区分每个frustum内部的不同射程分布和几何图案,我们设计了雷-相通几何分布编码(RAGDE)模块. 点由它们的射线范围以及射线相接坐标系统中的微小相抵明确代表出;而多频正弦和相弦函数则用于傅里叶特征[23]绘图,以增进不同空间组织模式之间的代表差异. 为了提高frustum特性的全球建模能力,我们设计了一个Scan-Topology-Aware Mamba(STAM)块。 该模块按照LiDAR方位角取样模式依次组织特征,并借助曼巴[24]捕捉扫描区域之间的长距离依赖性,改善不同扫描区域间结构变化的体现和全球空间关系. 为了解决3D结构特征与深层互动过程中的2D花纹特征之间的脱钩问题,我们引入了Range-Constract Point-Frustum Fusion(RCPFF)机制,将距离信息作为连接2D预测和3D空间结构的共享提示,指导两种特征类型的协作更新,同时增强空间一致性和语义互补性.

blocks.en: Overall, our main contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献概括如下:

blocks.en: 1. We propose RaSFNet, a network for collaborative learning between 3D structural features and 2D frustum features. Unlike existing point-frustum interaction methods that lack persistent spatial constraints, RaSFNet explicitly models the geometric structures within frustums and LiDAR scanning relationships, while using range information to constrain the interaction between point and frustum features. 2. We propose RAGDE, which uses each frustum ray as a reference and encodes radial range, tangential offsets, and local variations with multi-frequency Fourier features to distinguish geometric distributions. 3. We propose a STAM Block, which reorganizes frustum features into sequences according to the LiDAR azimuth scanning pattern, extending feature extraction from fixed local neighborhoods to global scan-wise dependencies. 4. We propose RCPFF, which uses distance information to constrain the interaction between 3D structural and 2D frustum features, guiding their complementary updates while maintaining spatial correspondence. 5. Comprehensive experiments on the SemanticKITTI [ 13 ] and nuScenes [ 14 ] validation sets show that RaSFNet achieves mIoU scores of 70.2% and 77.7%, respectively.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Point Cloud Feature Encoding
blocks.zh: II-A 点云特性编码

blocks.en: Point cloud feature encoding aims to extract discriminative 3D geometric information from the spatial distribution of raw point clouds. PointNet [ 3 ] uses shared multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) for point-wise encoding, while PointNet++ [ 25 ] adds hierarchical local feature aggregation. RandLA-Net [ 4 ] strengthens neighborhood features through attentive local encoding. Cylinder3D [ 26 ] instead organizes points with cylindrical voxelization. Recent methods further improve point cloud representation from different perspectives. SFPNet [ 5 ] employs sparse focal point modulation to aggregate multi-level contextual information, PointGeo [ 27 ] jointly captures local and global geometric features, and MDSLCA [ 28 ] combines multi-scale local attention with dilated spatial attention to enhance structural representations over different spatial ranges. Unlike methods that directly process unordered point sets, RangeNet++ [ 15 ] projects range, 3D coordinates, and remission values onto a regular 2D grid, while SphereFormer [ 11 ] introduces radial windows to accommodate the distance-dependent sparsity of LiDAR point clouds. Although these methods enhance geometric feature encoding, their representations remain largely focused on local neighborhood structures, with insufficient explicit modeling of differences in range distributions, geometric patterns, and spatial organizations. Consequently, point sets with distinct structural characteristics may still produce similar encoded representations. In this work, we introduce RAGDE, which characterizes radial and tangential structures along the LiDAR sensing ray, while multi-frequency Fourier mapping improves the separability of local point distributions.

blocks.en: II-B Projected Image Feature Extraction
blocks.zh: 二-B 预计图像特征

blocks.en: Projection-image feature extraction transforms point clouds into structured image representations and leverages 2D networks to learn semantic features at different scales. RangeViT [ 17 ] divides the projected image into feature patches and employs Transformers [ 29 ] to integrate local details with global semantics, while RangeFormer [ 7 ] adopts a hierarchical Transformer architecture to strengthen feature interactions across different regions. Fast FMVNet [ 8 ] improves range-image representation through an efficient multi-scale architecture, whereas MINet [ 30 ] employs multiple feature paths at different scales with dense cross-scale interactions. RangeRet [ 31 ] introduces circular retention to exploit the 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} continuity of range images and model spatial dependencies through distance-aware decay. Nevertheless, the projected features in these methods are still organized primarily on regular 2D grids, with limited consideration of range and point-density variations across different azimuthal regions. In this work, we propose STAM, which reorganizes feature sequences according to the LiDAR azimuth sampling pattern and performs differentiated modeling across scanning regions.

blocks.en: II-C Point Cloud-Projected Image Feature Fusion
blocks.zh: II-C 点云预测图像特性

blocks.en: To compensate for the information loss caused by a single projected representation, point-projection fusion methods retain the original point features and exploit the spatial correspondence between points and image representations for cross-representation interaction. PRNet [ 18 ] introduces range-view projection and point-range convolution to dynamically map range-image features back to the original points. FRNet [ 9 ] employs point-frustum mappings to alternately propagate frustum features and aggregate point features across multiple network stages. HARP-NeXt [ 32 ] further develops a multi-scale point–range fusion backbone to enable interaction between 3D geometric information and 2D semantic information at different feature levels. MFINet [ 12 ] constructs 3D point-view, bird's-eye-view, and range-view branches, enabling bidirectional 3D-2D interaction through point-feature projection and 2D feature enhancement while integrating complementary information across different views. However, these methods mainly rely on fixed point–projection correspondences for feature fusion, without maintaining a shared geometric constraint during feature updates. In this work, we propose a RCPFF mechanism that treats the range information shared by both representations as a common geometric anchor and explicitly incorporates it into feature interaction and updating, preserving spatial correspondence while enhancing the complementary representation of 3D geometric and 2D semantic information.
blocks.zh: 为了补偿单个预测的表示所造成信息损失,点-投影聚变方法保留了原有的分点特征,并利用分点和图像表示之间的空间对应来进行交叉表示的相互作用. PRNet [18] 引入了射程-视野投影和点-射程缩放来动态地将射程-图像特征映射回原点. FRNet [9] 采用点-裂缝映射法,在多个网络阶段轮流传播花纹特征和集合点特征. HARP-NEXt [32] 进一步发展了多尺度点-距离聚变主干线,使3D几何信息与不同地物层次的2D语义信息能够相互作用. MFINet [12]构建了3D点景,鸟眼景,和射程景分支,通过点地投影和2D特性增强,使得双向3D-2D相互作用,同时整合了不同观点之间的互补信息. 然而,这些方法主要依靠固定点-预测函证进行特征聚变,在特征更新过程中没有保持共享的几何约束. 在这项工作中,我们提出一个RCPFF机制,将两个表达方式共享的范围信息作为共同的几何锚地对待,并明确将其纳入特征互动和更新中,维护空间通信,同时增强3D几何和2D语义信息的互补代表.

blocks.zh: 页:1 方法

blocks.en: Fig. 2: Overall architecture of the proposed RaSFNet. The network consists of RAGDE, STAM, RCPFF, and a prediction head. The input point cloud is encoded into 3D structural features and 2D frustum features, which are progressively updated through hierarchical feature extraction and cross-representation interaction, followed by feature fusion and final semantic prediction.
blocks.zh: 发相. 2:拟议的拉萨论坛网络的总体结构。 该网络由RAGDE,STAM,RCPFF等组成并设有一个预测头. 输入点云被编码为3D结构特征和2D花纹特征,它们通过分级特征提取和交叉代表的相互作用而逐渐得到更新,然后是特征聚变和最终语义预测.

blocks.en: RaSFNet enables collaborative learning between 3D structural representations and 2D frustum representations through multi-stage feature interaction, as illustrated in Fig. 2 . Given an input point cloud, spatial correspondences between points and frustums are first established according to the projection relationship, producing the corresponding 3D and 2D representations. RAGDE, STAM, and RCPFF are then integrated into successive feature stages to encode, update, and fuse the two types of features. Finally, the fused features are mapped back to the point space through the prediction head to generate point-wise semantic labels.

blocks.en: III-E Fusion Head Module
blocks.zh: 三-E 组合头模块

blocks.en: Multi-stage point-frustum feature interaction progressively updates the point and frustum features, yielding hierarchical representations with varying spatial resolutions and receptive fields. These hierarchical representations encode spatial information at different granularities, with high-resolution features preserving finer spatial details and features from deeper stages capturing responses over broader receptive fields. The fusion head aggregates the multi-stage point and frustum features to integrate these complementary representations into unified point and frustum representations. Specifically, the point features are concatenated and fused according to point-wise correspondences, whereas the frustum features are first upsampled to a common spatial resolution and then concatenated and fused. The fused frustum features are subsequently mapped back to the 3D point domain and further integrated with the fused point features for final point-wise semantic prediction.
blocks.zh: 多相点-裂变特征相互作用逐渐地更新了点和裂变特征,产生了具有不同空间分辨率和可接受域的分级表示. 这些分级表示法将不同颗粒地的空间信息编码,具有高分辨率的特征,从更深的阶段保存更细的空间细节和特征,从更广泛的可接受领域获取反应。 聚变头将多相点和花纹特征相加,将这些互补的表示融合到统一的分点和花纹表示. 具体地说,分点特征按照点位相通来调和并被熔接,而节点特征则首先被取样到一个共同的空间分辨率上再被调和并被熔接. 被引信的花纹特征随后被映射回了3D点域并被进一步与被引信的点特征相融合,以便进行最终的分点语义预测.

blocks.en: IV Experiments
blocks.zh: 四. 试验

blocks.en: In this section, we conduct systematic experiments to evaluate the effectiveness of RaSFNet for outdoor LiDAR point cloud semantic segmentation. Comparisons with state-of-the-art methods and ablation studies are conducted to assess its overall segmentation performance and the contributions of individual components, while qualitative results are provided to further demonstrate its segmentation performance.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们进行系统实验,评价RaSFNet对室外LiDAR点云语分解的有效性. 进行了与最新方法的比较并进行了消化研究,以评估其整体分解性能和单个组成部分的贡献,同时提供了定性结果来进一步展示其分解性能.

blocks.en: IV-A Datasets
blocks.zh: 数据集

blocks.en: We conduct comprehensive evaluations on two widely used outdoor LiDAR semantic segmentation datasets, SemanticKITTI [ 13 ] and nuScenes [ 14 ] , covering diverse real-world autonomous driving scenarios. SemanticKITTI [ 13 ] was collected in Karlsruhe, Germany, using a Velodyne HDL-64E LiDAR sensor, with a vertical field of view (FoV) ranging from − 25 ∘ -25^{\circ} to 3 ∘ 3^{\circ} . Following the official split, 19,130 LiDAR scans are used for training and 4,071 for validation. Each scan contains approximately 120,000 points, with 19 semantic categories considered for evaluation. nuScenes was collected using a 32-beam LiDAR sensor with a vertical FoV ranging from − 30 ∘ -30^{\circ} to 10 ∘ 10^{\circ} . It contains 28,130 training samples and 6,019 validation samples from 1,000 driving scenes. The dataset provides annotations across 32 semantic categories, of which 16 categories are evaluated for semantic segmentation.

blocks.en: IV-C Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 四-C 执行细节

blocks.en: Although SemanticKITTI [ 13 ] and nuScenes [ 14 ] differ in LiDAR beam count (64 vs. 32), both utilize a full 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} horizontal FoV. The range image resolutions were set to 64 × 1024 64\times 1024 and 32 × 1024 32\times 1024 for SemanticKITTI [ 13 ] and nuScenes [ 14 ] , respectively. Each projected point is represented by its 3D coordinates and reflectance intensity. The feature encoder uses channel dimensions of (64,128,256,256) and compresses the output to 20 channels, while the four backbone stages each output 128 channels. The model is trained for 250,000 iterations using AdamW with an initial learning rate of 0.001, a batch size of 4, and the OneCycle learning-rate policy. All experiments were conducted on two NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPUs.

blocks.en: IV-D Quantitative Results
blocks.zh: 四-D 量化结果

blocks.en: We compare RaSFNet with LiDAR semantic segmentation methods based on different representations, including point-based, sparse-voxel, bird's-eye-view, and range-view representations, on the SemanticKITTI [ 13 ] and nuScenes [ 14 ] validation sets. The results are presented in Tables I and II , respectively. RaSFNet achieves mIoU scores of 70.2% and 77.7% on the SemanticKITTI [ 13 ] and nuScenes [ 14 ] validation sets, respectively. On SemanticKITTI [ 13 ] , RaSFNet performs well in the motorcycle, parking, sidewalk, and fence classes. On nuScenes [ 14 ] , RaSFNet also obtains favorable results in the bicycle, motorcycle, bus, and pedestrian classes. The results suggest that RaSFNet maintains competitive overall accuracy and performs well across several semantic classes.

blocks.en: As the sensing distance increases, the spatial sampling density of LiDAR point clouds gradually decreases, accompanied by an overall decline in semantic segmentation performance across different methods. Near-range regions generally yield higher mIoU than far-range regions, indicating the performance variation under different point-density conditions. Table III provides a quantitative comparison of semantic segmentation performance and corresponding point density across different sensing-distance ranges on the SemanticKITTI [ 13 ] validation set. The average point density decreases from 923.8 to 13.1 points/m 3 with increasing sensing distance. Our method achieves mIoUs of 77.5%, 71.3%, 65.9%, 59.9%, and 45.3% in the 0-5 m, 5-10 m, 10-20 m, 20-40 m, and 40-50 m ranges, respectively, achieving the highest mIoU among the compared methods in all five ranges. For the 50-60 m range, our method achieves an mIoU of 25.4%, close to the highest value of 26.0%. Overall, favorable segmentation performance is maintained in both high-density near-range regions and low-density middle- and far-range regions. Distance-aware modeling of image feature extraction and point-image feature interaction facilitates adaptation to feature representation variations across different sensing distances.

blocks.zh: 图 5. 语义KITTI [13] val set上挑战场景的分片错误. 红色代表错分类区域,而灰色代表错分类区域.

blocks.en: Maintaining spatial consistency remains challenging in LiDAR semantic segmentation, particularly within large-scale semantic regions. Existing methods may generate locally clustered errors that spread across semantic boundaries, resulting in fragmented predictions. Fig. 5 presents qualitative comparisons in three representative scenarios: a densely vegetated area, a road-terrain boundary, and a crossroad intersection. Across these scenarios, the compared methods exhibit clustered errors within vegetation or continuous misclassifications along road boundaries and connecting branches. RaSFNet produces fewer misclassified points, with more scattered errors and more coherent predicted regions. Its design considers both local geometric differences and global spatial relationships, allowing semantic discrimination to draw on fine-grained structural details and broader contextual information.
blocks.zh: 在LiDAR语义分解中,特别是在大规模语义区,保持空间一致性仍然是个挑战。 现有方法可能会产生由地层组合而成的、跨越语义界限的错误,从而导致零散的预测。 图5按三种有代表性的情况进行了定性比较:植被密集地段、道路-地铁边界和十字路口。 在这些假设中,比较方法显示出植被内部的集群错误或沿道路边界和连接分支的持续错误分类。 RaSFNet产生的错分点较少,错误更分散,预测区域更一致. 其设计既考虑局部几何差异,又考虑全球空间关系,使语义上的歧视能够取用精细的结构细节和更广泛的背景信息.

blocks.en: Fig. 6: Qualitative comparison of semantic segmentation results on the SemanticKITTI [ 13 ] validation set.
blocks.zh: 发相. 6:语义分解结果在语义KITTI[13]验证集上的定性比较.

blocks.en: To evaluate the ability of RaSFNet to distinguish semantically different classes with similar local geometric structures, Fig. 6 presents qualitative comparisons with FRNet [ 9 ] , RangeRet [ 31 ] , and VaViT [ 41 ] in three challenging scenes. Incomplete observations and occlusion obscure distinctive geometric characteristics, while similar planar geometry makes terrain and sidewalk difficult to distinguish. Across these scenes, the compared methods exhibit confusion between bus and car, terrain and vegetation, or terrain and sidewalk, whereas RaSFNet more accurately identifies the highlighted regions. RaSFNet enhances subtle geometric differences through encoding and guides the collaborative updating of 3D structural features and 2D frustum features under persistent spatial constraints, thereby improving semantic discrimination between regions with similar local geometric structures.
blocks.zh: 为了评价RASFNet区分具有相近地几何结构的分類的能力,图6在三个有挑战性的场景中,提出了与FRNet [9],RangeRet [31],和VaViT [41]的定性比较. 不完整的观测和隔离模糊了独特的几何特征,而类似的平面几何使得地形和人行道难以区分. 在这些场景中,比较方法显示出公交车和汽车、地势和植被、地势和人行道之间的混淆,而RaSFNet则更准确地识别出突出的区域。 RaSFNet通过编码来增强细微的几何差异,并指导在持续空间限制下合作更新3D结构特征和2D花纹特征,从而改善具有相近地几何结构的区域之间的语义歧视.

blocks.en: Fig. 7: Qualitative comparison of semantic segmentation results across a temporal sequence on the SemanticKITTI [ 13 ] validation set.
blocks.zh: 发相. 7:语义分解结果在语义KITTI[13]验证集上跨出时间序列进行定性比较.

blocks.en: Long-range semantic perception remains challenging because increasing sensing distance substantially reduces the density of LiDAR measurements. Sparse measurements provide incomplete geometric structures and limited class-discriminative cues, increasing the likelihood of recognition errors. As shown in Fig. 7 , segmentation results are compared for the same bus at progressively greater distances across consecutive frames. FRNet [ 9 ] and RangeRet [ 31 ] produce incorrect labels within the bus region, with segmentation completeness deteriorating as the sensing distance increases. By contrast, RaSFNet preserves a more complete bus region across the examined distances, demonstrating greater robustness to the feature degradation associated with sparse long-range observations.
blocks.zh: 长距离语义感知仍然具有挑战性,因为增加感知距离会大大地降低LiDAR测量的密度. 分层测量提供了不完整的几何结构和有限的分级提示,增加了识别出错的可能性. 如图7所示,对同一班车的分接结果进行了比较,其距离相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相接。 FRNet [9]和RangeRet [31]在公交区域内产生不正确的标签,分块完整性随着感知距离的增大而恶化. 相比之下,RaSFNet在所检查的距离上保持了更为完整的总线区域,表明与稀有远程观测相关的特征退化的强度更大。

blocks.en: IV-F Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 四-F 关系研究

blocks.en: Component Ablation: Table IV evaluates the contributions of RAGDE, STAM, and RCPFF through leave-one-component-out experiments under identical training settings. Removing RCPFF reduces mIoU by 2.7 percentage points on SemanticKITTI and 2.2 percentage points on nuScenes, highlighting the importance of effectively integrating 3D structural information with 2D frustum features. Removing STAM also degrades performance on both datasets, suggesting that axis-aware aggregation and serpentine sequence modeling help capture contextual information from the encoded geometric features. Removing RAGDE reduces both mIoU and mAcc, supporting the contribution of ray-aligned encoding to local geometric representation. These consistent trends across the two datasets support the contributions of RAGDE, STAM, and RCPFF within the overall framework. The complete configuration outperforms all ablated variants in both mIoU and mAcc on both datasets.
blocks.zh: 构成部分分离:表四通过在相同培训环境下的一元分离试验,评价了区域两性平等网络、科学、技术和创新网络以及区域森林方案的贡献。 取消RCPFF将mIoU在语义KITTI上减少2.7个百分点,在nuScens上减少2.2个百分点,凸显出将3D结构信息与2D花纹特征有效融合的重要性. 删除STAM也会降低两个数据集的性能,表明轴-意识聚合和蛇纹花序模型有助于从被编码的几何特征中获取上下文信息. 移除RAGDE会同时减少mIoU和mAcc,支持射线相接编码对局部几何表示的贡献. 这两套数据集的这些一致趋势支持了非洲性别平等网络、科学、技术和创新网络以及区域森林方案在总体框架内的贡献。 完整的配置在mIoU和mAcc两个数据集上都超过了所有被放弃的变体.

blocks.en: Component Designs: Table V compares segmentation performance and parameter counts when the original modules are replaced with alternative encoding, sequence modeling, and fusion methods. The evaluated replacement configurations contain 8.1M-21.7M parameters and achieve mIoU scores of 66.1%-68.6%. In comparison, RaSFNet achieves 70.2% mIoU and 76.6% mAcc with 8.0M parameters, outperforming the evaluated alternatives. These differences are associated with how geometric information is modeled: the respective replacement methods do not explicitly characterize differences in range distributions and geometric organization along sensing rays, organize feature sequences according to LiDAR azimuthal sampling patterns, or maintain a shared range constraint throughout point-frustum feature updates. RaSFNet explicitly accounts for these geometric and sampling characteristics, enabling more discriminative feature encoding and spatially constrained point-frustum interaction.
blocks.zh: 组件设计:表 V比较了原模块被替代编码,序列建模和聚变方法所取代时的分化性能和参数计数. 被评价的替换配置包含8.1M-21.7M参数并实现mIoU分数66.1%-68.6%. 相比之下,RaSFNet在8.0M参数下实现了70.2% mIoU和76.6% mAcc,超过了所评估的替代品。 这些差异与几何信息如何被建模有关:相邻的替换方法没有明确描述范围分布和沿遥感射线几何组织的差异,按照LiDAR方位角采样模式组织地物序列,或者在整个点-弗鲁斯通地物更新过程中保持共享范围约束. RaSFNet明确说明了这些几何和采样特征,从而能够进行更多的区分特征编码和空间受限的点-裂变相互作用。

blocks.en: Range-Image Resolution: Range-image resolution determines the angular coverage of each frustum and the distribution of projected points. Table VI compares different resolutions on both datasets. A low resolution assigns more points to each frustum, which may increase projection conflicts and obscure local structures near semantic boundaries. Increasing the resolution separates projected points more effectively, whereas an excessively fine grid creates sparsely occupied frustums and limits feature aggregation. Consequently, neither mIoU nor mAcc improves monotonically with increasing image width. Among the evaluated configurations, SemanticKITTI achieves the highest mIoU and mAcc at 64 × 1024 64\times 1024 , while nuScenes achieves the highest values at 32 × 480 32\times 480 .
blocks.zh: 范围图像分辨率 : 射程成像分辨率决定了每个节点的角覆盖和预测点的分布. 表六比较了两个数据集的不同分辨率。 低解析度为每节节会分配出更多的分数,这可能会增加预测冲突并模糊靠近语义边界的地方结构. 增加分辨率可以更有效地将预测点分开,而过于精细的网格则会产生稀少的被占用的花纹和限制地物聚集。 因此,mIoU和mAcc都无法单调地随着图像宽度的增加而改进。 在评价的配置中,语义KITTI在64×1024 64\times 1024实现最高mIoU和mAcc,而nuScenes在32×480 32\times 480实现最高值.

blocks.en: V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: This paper presented RaSFNet for projection-based LiDAR semantic segmentation. Guided by the physical acquisition characteristics of LiDAR, RaSFNet amplifies subtle differences among similar local point distributions through ray-aligned encoding, serializes frustum features in a serpentine row-wise order along the azimuthal dimension, and uses range information shared by point and frustum representations to constrain their bidirectional updates. Across the evaluated datasets, RaSFNet produces more coherent semantic regions and clearer class boundaries, with less confusion between spatially adjacent classes that share similar geometric structures. Class-wise evaluations and ablation studies provide further analyses of the segmentation performance and the roles of the main components. Future work will explore extending RaSFNet to other 3D perception tasks, including 3D object detection and semantic occupancy prediction.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍了基于投影的LiDAR语义分解的RASFNet. 在LiDAR物理获取特性的指导下,RASFNet通过射线相通编码来放大类似局部点分布之间的细微差异,沿方位角维度以蛇形行序顺序将frustum特征序列化,并使用点和frustum表达法共享的范围信息来限制其双向更新. 在整个被评价的数据集中,RASFNet产生更连贯的语义区域和更清晰的类分界线,空间相邻的类之间较少混淆,这些类具有相似的几何结构. 分级评价和分级研究进一步分析了分级业绩和主要组成部分的作用。 未来的工作将探索将RASFNet扩展到其他3D感知任务,包括3D物体检测和语义占用预测.
